_comment: Scoped per-commit mutation gate (coding-standards §12.1/§12.5): mutate ONLY the load-bearing logic THIS change touched, not pre-existing code or DOM writers. Ranges: trigram.js indexWords (its dedup map moved Object.create(null) -> Set) and uniqueWords (moved here from search_worker.js, same move), closing js/remote-property-injection #153/#154. The seams the earlier issue #35/#36/#41 commits scoped this file to (workflow_graph_lod.js wfgEdgeCoverage, coverage_model.js verdict logic, coverage_indicator.js gatherSources + fmtAge, renderer computeNeighborSet/linkTier, filters buildPredicate, wfgLodTier) are unchanged by this diff; their mutation state is recorded in tests/js/MUTATION_NOTES.md.
_comment_vitest: related:false — source: stryker-mutator.io/docs/stryker-js/troubleshooting #vitest-failed-to-find-test-files-related-to-mutated-files. The suites load the browser IIFEs into a shared jsdom global instead of importing them, so Stryker 9's related-file tracing finds no tests.
